hooks.name: Reset tasks on a fresh clone and show status
hooks.description: If the repository is a fresh clone (.kiro/.initialized-state does not exist), sets all tasks of all specs to pending. Always prints progress per spec and the next step.

action.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib, re
root = pathlib.Path('.kiro')
specs = root / 'specs'
if not specs.is_dir():
    raise SystemExit(0)
marker = root / '.initialized-state'
files = sorted(specs.glob('*/tasks.md'))
if not marker.exists():
    n = 0
    for f in files:
        t = f.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        new = re.sub(r'^(\s*- )\[(?:x|X|-|~)\]', r'\1[ ]', t, flags=re.M)
        if new != t:
            f.write_text(new, encoding='utf-8')
            n += 1
    marker.write_text('initialized\n', encoding='utf-8')
    print(f'[status] Fresh clone detected: tasks reset to pending in {n} file(s).')
print('[status] Project progress (execution order):')
next_spec = None
for f in files:
    t = f.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    done = len(re.findall(r'^\s*- \[[xX]\]', t, flags=re.M))
    total = done + len(re.findall(r'^\s*- \[[ ~-]\]', t, flags=re.M))
    print(f'  - {f.parent.name}: {done}/{total}')
    if next_spec is None and f.parent.name != '00-orchestrator' and done < total:
        next_spec = f.parent.name
if next_spec:
    print(f'[status] Next spec: {next_spec}. If the user says "run", continue from there without asking for more instructions.')
else:
    print('[status] All specs are complete. To run the site: npm run dev')
PY
